youtube.baslik: In what order do experienced readers read a paper? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Experienced readers do not read a paper straight through. They check the abstract first and decide whether the paper fits their question; next they examine the tables and figures, because the core of the findings is often there. Then the methods are read carefully, and the discussion is read last, because the authors' interpretation is not always the same as what the data really show.
